io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories

Class CategoryMenuBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories.CategoryMenuBuilder

  • public final class CategoryMenuBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
    Builds the transient CategoryItemGroup tiles for the categorized main menu. Slimefun's own groups keep their curated category and their own names; every enabled ADDON item is pulled from the registry, classified by type (ItemTypeClassifier) and grouped into "<Addon> <Type>" section tiles under the matching type category - so an addon's items split across the shared categories even when the addon's own guide is a single custom flex UI. Anything the classifier can't type lands in the addon's Misc section (never dropped).

        The localized display label for the category an ItemGroup is filed under - the same lookup tile(org.bukkit.entity.Player, io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.categories.GuideCategory, java.util.List<io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.ItemGroup>) uses for the category-menu tiles, exposed for anywhere else in the guide that needs to show a group's owning category (e.g. search results). Every SlimefunItem belongs to exactly one ItemGroup, and every ItemGroup resolves to exactly one category here, so there is no multi-category case to reconcile - an undeclared or unknown category id simply falls back to DefaultGuideCategories.MISC.
